text: at dawn the little robot rolled into the garden. it counted three red flowers and two blue stones.
at noon the little robot rested beneath the oak tree. a bright bird sang above its silver head.
at dusk the little robot carried seeds to the garden. soft rain tapped on its metal hands.
the garden woke with warm light. bees moved between flowers while the little robot watched.
the garden slept beneath the moon. the little robot listened to frogs beside the pond.
a red flower opened near the old stone wall. the little robot wrote the moment in its notebook.
a blue bird landed on the wooden gate. the little robot greeted it with a quiet whistle.
rain filled the pond and washed the leaves. the little robot rolled home along the muddy path.
every morning the robot checked the seeds. every evening it counted the new green leaves.
small wheels crossed the garden path. small hands planted seeds in dark soft earth.
the robot found a smooth stone by the pond. it placed the stone beside a yellow flower.
under the oak tree, the robot read its notes: flowers grow, birds sing, and rain returns.
